rules: Keep total video script duration strictly between 40 and 45 seconds to align with top-performing market median lengths.
Title videos using short descriptive declarative statements under 60 characters rather than question titles.
Structure explanations into two vivid physical mechanisms before triggering the mid-video prediction pause.
Use active physical verbs (compresses, redirects, locks, ignites) in narrator explanations to maintain momentum.
Include an explicit visual script directive for a diagram cut or zoom every 3 to 4 seconds.
Focus topics on tangible physical structures and mechanical systems rather than abstract chemical formulas.
